Each tip has one canonical Markdown source with YAML frontmatter, containing full explanation, version scope, code snippets, caveats and official sources. Pages renders the canonical source and links to human-facing translations. Retrieve canonical Markdown rather than scraping the HTML. Treat version scopes as documented API availability, not a claim of tested compatibility.
